mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, product_id, quantity, locked_quantity, average_price, updated_at FROM holdings WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND product_id = #{productId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO holdings ( member_id, product_id, quantity, locked_quantity, average_price ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{lockedQuantity}, #{averagePrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT h.id AS holding_id, h.product_id, p.category, p.name AS product_name, h.quantity, h.locked_quantity, (h.quantity - h.locked_quantity) AS available_quantity, h.average_price, p.token_price AS current_price, (h.quantity * p.token_price) AS valuation_amount, ((h.quantity * p.token_price) * IFNULL(p.expected_yield, 0) / 100) AS expected_annual_dividend, p.expected_yield, CASE WHEN h.average_price = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ((p.token_price - h.average_price) / h.average_price * 100) END AS profit_rate FROM holdings h JOIN products p ON h.product_id = p.id WHERE h.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.updated_at DESC, h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(h.quantity * p.token_price), 0) FROM holdings h JOIN products p ON h.product_id = p.id WHERE h.member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT IFNULL(SUM((h.quantity * p.token_price) * IFNULL(p.expected_yield, 0) / 100), 0) FROM holdings h JOIN products p ON h.product_id = p.id WHERE h.member_id = #{memberId}
